summary: Verified Dropbox OAuth preflight fix. GET /api/admin/dropbox/oauth/start (admin bearer) returns 400 with detail 'Dropbox says: Invalid redirect_uri: "https://all-is-good--31c91em5.preview.emergentagent.com/api/dropbox/oauth/callback": It must exactly match...' and no url. Unauthenticated -> 401/403. UI: login via /admin/login, clicking dropbox-connect-button keeps user on /admin and shows sonner error toast with the Dropbox message. Regression: admin panel loads with 5 projects, Dropbox card shows 'Not connected' and correct redirect URI; home page renders.

minor.issue: requests.get preflight to dropbox.com is not wrapped in try/except; a network error/timeout would surface as 500 instead of a friendly 502. Also, the oauth_state is inserted before the preflight, so a failed preflight leaves an orphan state behind (the TTL index on expires_at cleans it up, so the impact is low).

action_items: User must add https://all-is-good--31c91em5.preview.emergentagent.com/api/dropbox/oauth/callback to the Redirect URIs in the Dropbox App Console (OAuth 2 section). This is a user-side config step.
Optional: wrap the preflight requests.get in try/except requests.RequestException -> HTTPException(502)
critical_code_review_comments: Preflight network errors aren't handled (would return 500)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids: admin-login-email-input / admin-login-password-input / admin-login-submit-button. Successful Dropbox OAuth can't be tested until the user registers the redirect URI.
